author: Horatius Bonar
title_en: Do You Go to the Prayer Meeting?
title_tet: Ó Bá Iha Enkontru Orasaun Ka Lae?
subtitle_en: An Earnest Call to Gather Together for Prayer and Eternity
subtitle_tet: Bolun Séria Ida Atu Halibur Hamutuk Ba Orasaun no Eternidade

cards.scripture_en: "With joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation" (Isa 12:3).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ho ksolok imi sei kuru bee husi posu salvasaun nian" (Isaías 12:3).
cards.body_en: Reader! Is there a prayer meeting in your neighborhood? If there is, do you attend it? If you do not, have you good reasons for staying away? Perhaps there is one just by your door, or at least within a few minutes’ walk of your dwelling. Do you go to it? I have known people walk many miles every week to a prayer meeting. They did not grudge the distance. The way seemed short and pleasant. No wonder. They were in earnest about their souls! And if you neglect or despise such meetings, it is to be feared that you are altogether unconcerned about eternity and the kingdom to come. If you were thirsty for the water of life, you would be glad of such opportunities of drawing it out of the wells of salvation.
cards.body_tet: Leitór! Iha enkontru orasaun ida iha ó-nia viziñansa ka lae? Se iha, ó bá tuir ka lae? Se la bá, ó iha razaun di'ak atu hela sees ka lae? Karik iha ida iha ó-nia odamatan, ka pelumenus minutu balun la'o ain husi ó-nia hela-fatin. Ó bá ka lae? Ha'u hatene ema sira ne'ebé la'o milha barak kada semana ba enkontru orasaun ida. Sira la hanoin kona-ba distánsia. Dalan haree hanesan badak no furak. La hakfodak. Sira sériu kona-ba sira-nia klamar! No se ó neglijénsia ka hakribi enkontru sira-ne'e, tenke tauk katak ó la preokupa hotu kona-ba eternidade no reinu ne'ebé atu mai. Se ó hamrook ba bee moris nian, ó sei kontente ho oportunidade sira-ne'e atu kuru bee husi posu salvasaun nian.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Those truly earnest about their souls and eternity gladly value and attend prayer meetings.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Sira ne'ebé sériu duni kona-ba sira-nia klamar no eternidade ho haksolok valoriza no bá enkontru orasaun sira.

cards.section_heading_en: Solemn Warning - The Vanities of Earth and Eternity
cards.section_heading_tet: Avizu Séria - Vaidade Rai Nian no Eternidade
cards.scripture_en: "The end of all things is at hand; be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer" (1 Pet 4:7).
cards.scripture_tet: "Buat hotu nia rohan besik ona; tanba ne'e imi sai sériu no vijila ba orasaun" (1 Pedro 4:7).
cards.body_en: Very soon the last sermon will be done, the last Sabbath will close, the last prayer meeting will be over, the last message of salvation delivered, the last warning sounded, and the last invitation given! Then, what bitter regret and agonizing remorse! What will you think of your excuses then? Oh, you will give the wealth of worlds for another prayer meeting, another day of hope. No more making light of such precious opportunities, nor scoffing at those who prized them! The follies and vanities of earth are all over then; and invisible realities are seen to be all in all. Will the remembered hours of carnal levity, the idle word, the thoughtless jest—all of which you once preferred to the prayer meeting—breathe comfort to your dying soul, or bear you up when giving in your account before the Judge of all?
cards.body_tet: Lalais de'it sermaun ikus sei hotu, Sábadu ikus sei taka, enkontru orasaun ikus sei remata, mensajen salvasaun ikus sei hato'o, avizu ikus sei lian, no konvite ikus sei fó! Hafoin ne'e, arrependimentu moruk no laran-susar todan oinsá mak sei mosu! Ó sei hanoin saida kona-ba ó-nia deskulpa sira iha tempu ne'ebá? Oh, ó sei fó rikusoin mundu nian ba enkontru orasaun ida tan, loron esperansa ida tan. La iha tan trata kmaan oportunidade folin-boot sira-ne'e, ka goza sira ne'ebé valoriza ida-ne'e! Beik-teen no vaidade rai nian hotu ona iha tempu ne'ebá; no realidade ne'ebé matan la haree hatudu sai nu'udar buat hotu. Oras sira kona-ba kmaan isin nian, liafuan mamuk, piada sein hanoin—ne'ebé uluk ó hili liu fali enkontru orasaun—sei fó kmaan ba ó-nia klamar ne'ebé atu mate, ka sustenta ó bainhira fó konta iha Juís boot liu hotu nia oin ka lae?
cards.key_takeaway_en: Earthly vanities and excuses cannot comfort the soul at death or judgment; eternal realities outweigh all else.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Vaidade rai nian no deskulpa sira la bele fó kmaan ba klamar iha mate ka julgamentu; realidade rohan-laek boot liu buat hotu.

cards.section_heading_en: 1. Do You Not Care for Prayer Meetings?
cards.section_heading_tet: 1. Ó La Interese Ba Enkontru Orasaun Ka?
cards.scripture_en: "Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world" (1 John 2:15).
cards.scripture_tet: "Keta hadomi mundu, no mós buat sira ne'ebé iha mundu" (1 João 2:15).
cards.body_en: Do you not care for prayer meetings? Do you not like them? Do you count them a weariness, or do you call them fanaticism? Is this your reason? If so, can your soul be in a right state with God? Can that man be a child of God who dislikes either private or social prayer? Can there be real or living religion in that soul that does not relish such meetings? Is it not strange and sad that you should relish the things of the body, the things of time—and yet turn away from the things of the soul, the things of eternity? Is it not awful that you should love the society of sinners, the friendship of the world; and yet dislike so much the companionship of saints, the fellowship of God. If you prefer worldly company or pleasure to a prayer meeting, this shows beyond all doubt that you are not a child of God, or a follower of the Lamb.
cards.body_tet: Ó la interese ba enkontru orasaun ka? Ó la gosta sira ka? Ó sura sira nu'udar kolen, ka bolu sira fanatizmu? Ida-ne'e mak ó-nia razaun ka? Se nune'e, ó-nia klamar bele iha estadu loos ho Maromak ka lae? Ema ida ne'ebé la gosta orasaun privadu ka orasaun hamutuk bele sai Maromak nia oan ka lae? Bele iha relijiaun loos ka moris iha klamar ne'ebé la gosta enkontru sira-ne'e ka lae? La estrañu no triste ka katak ó gosta buat isin nian, buat tempu nian—maibé fila kotuk ba buat klamar nian, buat eternidade nian? La aat tebes ka katak ó hadomi sosiedade ema sala-na'in nian, amizade mundu nian; maibé la gosta tebes kompañia santu sira nian, komuñaun Maromak nian. Se ó hili liu maluk ka ksolok mundanu duké enkontru orasaun, ida-ne'e hatudu sein dúvida katak ó la'ós Maromak nia oan, ka dixípulu Bibi-Oan nian.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Disliking prayer and preferring worldly company or pleasure reveals a heart estranged from God.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: La gosta orasaun no hili liu maluk ka ksolok mundanu hatudu fuan ne'ebé dok husi Maromak.

cards.section_heading_en: 2. Have You No Time to Attend Prayer Meetings?
cards.section_heading_tet: 2. Ó La Iha Tempu Atu Bá Enkontru Orasaun Ka?
cards.scripture_en: "Redeeming the time, because the days are evil" (Eph 5:16).
cards.scripture_tet: "Sosa fali tempu, tanba loron sira aat" (Éfezu 5:16).
cards.body_en: Have you no time to attend prayer meetings? Is this your reason? Ah! Think for a moment, is it really true that you have no time to spare for them? Can you say so honestly before God? Will you be able to plead this with the Judge in the great day of account? Do you never attend other meetings which take up more of your time? Or do you not waste more time idly, or in foolish company, than would be spent at the meeting? What? Have you time to eat, and to drink, and make merry, but none to pray? Have you time for business, for company, for folly, for pleasure, for lusts, for sin, but none for prayer? You can spare days and weeks for the things of time. Can you not spare an hour for the things of eternity?
cards.body_tet: Ó la iha tempu atu bá enkontru orasaun ka? Ida-ne'e mak ó-nia razaun ka? Ah! Hanoin uitoan, loos duni ka katak ó la iha tempu atu rezerva ba sira? Ó bele dehan nune'e ho onestu iha Maromak nia oin ka lae? Ó sei bele hato'o ida-ne'e ba Juís iha loron boot konta nian ka lae? Ó nunka bá enkontru seluk ne'ebé foti tempu barak liu ka lae? Ka ó gasta tempu barak liu ho mamuk, ka hamutuk ho maluk beik, duké tempu ne'ebé uza iha enkontru ka lae? Saida? Ó iha tempu atu han, no hemu, no haksolok, maibé la iha atu harohan? Ó iha tempu ba negósiu, ba maluk, ba beik-teen, ba ksolok, ba hakarak aat, ba sala, maibé la iha ba orasaun? Ó bele rezerva loron no semana ba buat tempu nian. Ó la bele rezerva oras ida ba buat eternidade nian ka?
cards.key_takeaway_en: Claiming no time for prayer is hollow when hours and days are freely given to business, pleasure, and worldly pursuits.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Dehan la iha tempu ba orasaun la iha folin bainhira fó oras no loron ba negósiu, ksolok no buat mundanu sira.

cards.section_heading_en: 3. Are You Ashamed to Go to a Prayer Meeting?
cards.section_heading_tet: 3. Ó Mae Atu Bá Enkontru Orasaun Ka?
cards.scripture_en: "Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words... of him shall the Son of man be ashamed" (Mark 8:38).
cards.scripture_tet: "Tanba ne'e ema hotu ne'ebé moe ba Ha'u no Ha'u-nia liafuan... Oan-Mane Ema nian mós sei moe ba nia" (Markos 8:38).
cards.body_en: Are you ashamed to go to a prayer meeting? Would your companions laugh at you? Is this your reason? What? Ashamed to pray! Afraid to be laughed at! You are not ashamed to be seen in idle, foolish company, yet you are ashamed to be seen in the society of the people of God! You are not ashamed to saunter about the streets, nor to “stand in the way of sinners,” nor to “sit in the seat of the scornful” (Psa 1:1), yet you are ashamed to be seen at a meeting for prayer! Ashamed of God’s service, but not ashamed of the devil’s! Ashamed to pray, but not ashamed to sin! Will God accept such an excuse at your hands in the day of reckoning?
cards.body_tet: Ó moe atu bá enkontru orasaun ka? Ó-nia maluk sira sei hamnasa ó ka? Ida-ne'e mak ó-nia razaun ka? Saida? Moe atu harohan! Tauk ema hamnasa! Ó la moe atu haree iha maluk mamuk no beik nia leet, maibé ó moe atu haree iha sosiedade Maromak nia povu! Ó la moe atu la'o-lemo iha dalan, ka "hamriik iha ema sala-na'in nia dalan", ka "tuur iha ema goza-na'in nia kadeira" (Salmu 1:1), maibé ó moe atu haree iha enkontru orasaun! Moe ba servisu Maromak nian, maibé la moe ba diabu nian! Moe atu harohan, maibé la moe atu halo sala! Maromak sei simu deskulpa hanesan ne'e husi ó iha loron akontabilidade ka lae?
cards.key_takeaway_en: Being ashamed of prayer while unashamed of sin or worldly company exposes misplaced fear of men over Christ.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Moe ba orasaun enkuantu la moe ba sala ka maluk mundanu hatudu tauk ba ema ne'ebé liu fali Kristu.

cards.section_heading_en: 4. Do You Think It Is Being Too Religious?
cards.section_heading_tet: 4. Ó Hanoin Ida-Ne'e Relijiozu Liu Ka?
cards.scripture_en: "They are before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple" (Rev 7:15).
cards.scripture_tet: "Sira iha Maromak nia tronu oin, no serbí Nia loron no kalan iha Ninia templu" (Apokalipse 7:15).
cards.body_en: Do you think it is being too religious? Now let me ask you what you mean by “religious”? Does it not mean loving and serving God? And can a man love God too much? Can he serve Him too constantly or devotedly? Are the angels and the redeemed saints in heaven too religious, who serve Him “day and night in His temple” (Rev 7:15)? With such a feeling as you have about prayer meetings, it is plain that there is far too much religion in heaven for you ever to think of going to such a place, or even to wish to be there. The man that has no relish for a prayer meeting, could have no relish for heaven. He is utterly unfit to be there. He would be wretched there. An eternity of prayer and praise would be hell to a man who is wearied with an hour of a prayer meeting on earth.
cards.body_tet: Ó hanoin ida-ne'e relijiozu liu ka? Agora husik ha'u husu ó saida mak ó hakarak dehan ho "relijiozu"? Ida-ne'e la signifika hadomi no serbí Maromak ka? No ema ida bele hadomi Maromak barak liu ka? Bele serbí Nia ho kontínuu ka devotu liu ka? Anju sira no santu sira ne'ebé hetan redensaun iha lalehan relijiozu liu ka, ne'ebé serbí Nia "loron no kalan iha Ninia templu" (Apokalipse 7:15)? Ho sentimentu hanesan ne'e ne'ebé ó iha kona-ba enkontru orasaun, klaru katak iha relijiaun barak liu iha lalehan atu ó hanoin bá fatin hanesan ne'e, ka hakarak hela iha ne'ebá. Ema ne'ebé la gosta enkontru orasaun la bele gosta lalehan. Nia la merese hotu atu bá ne'ebá. Nia sei sente terus iha ne'ebá. Eternidade orasaun no louvór nian sei sai infernu ba ema ne'ebé kole ho oras ida enkontru orasaun nian iha rai.
cards.key_takeaway_en: One cannot love God too much; disliking earthly prayer shows unfitness for eternal worship in heaven.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Ema la bele hadomi Maromak barak liu; la gosta orasaun iha rai hatudu la preparadu ba adorasaun rohan-laek iha lalehan.

cards.section_heading_en: 5. Are You Better Employed at Home?
cards.section_heading_tet: 5. Ó Halo Serbisu Di'ak Liu Iha Uma Ka?
cards.scripture_en: "Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is" (Heb 10:25).
cards.scripture_tet: "La husik halibur hamutuk, hanesan balun nia kostume" (Ebreu 10:25).
cards.body_en: Are you better employed at home? Can you honestly say so before God? If you can, I leave you to answer to God for the time thus spent at home or elsewhere. He will take a strict account of those hours. If you are one who loves to read the Bible and pray at home, I am sure you will not object to a meeting for prayer. If you are not, can you really say that you are better employed, or even half so well? Oh, no. You cannot be half so well employed as in preparing for eternity, in praying with God’s people, in hearing of His dear Son, in making ready for the coming of the Lord.
cards.body_tet: Ó halo serbisu di'ak liu iha uma ka? Ó bele dehan nune'e ho onestu iha Maromak nia oin ka? Se bele, ha'u husik ó atu hatán ba Maromak kona-ba tempu ne'ebé uza iha uma ka iha fatin seluk. Nia sei foti konta rigorozu ba oras sira-ne'e. Se ó mak ida ne'ebé gosta lee Bíblia no harohan iha uma, ha'u fiar katak ó sei la kontra enkontru orasaun ida. Se la'ós, ó bele dehan duni katak ó halo serbisu di'ak liu, ka pelumenus metade di'ak hanesan ne'e ka? Oh, lae. Ó la bele halo serbisu metade di'ak hanesan prepara ba eternidade, harohan hamutuk ho Maromak nia povu, rona kona-ba Ninia Oan-Mane doben, no prepara aan ba Na'i nia mai.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Genuine private devotion naturally leads believers to gather and pray with God's people rather than stay away.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Devoesaun privadu ne'ebé loos lori fiar-na'in sira atu halibur no harohan hamutuk ho Maromak nia povu duké hela sees.

cards.section_heading_en: Conclusion - The Real Root and the Urgent Call
cards.section_heading_tet: Konkluzaun - Abut Loos no Bolun Urjente
cards.scripture_en: "Because the carnal mind is enmity against God" (Rom 8:7).
cards.scripture_tet: "Tanba hanoin isin nian mak inimigu hasoru Maromak" (Roma 8:7).
cards.body_en: Reader, are these your reasons? Then I ask you, are they sufficient? Does your conscience say they are? Or do you not see that the real reason is just your “carnal mind which is enmity against God” (Rom 8:7)? You do not love to pray, therefore you do not like the prayer meeting. You do not love God, and therefore you do not desire fellowship with Him. You do not love His saints, therefore you do not wish to join with them in prayer. You do not care about forgiveness of sin, and you have no relish for the things of Christ. “The end of all things is at hand; be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer” (1 Pet 4:7). “Not forsaking the assembling of yourselves together, as the manner of some is...” (Heb 10:25).
cards.body_tet: Leitór, sira-ne'e mak ó-nia razaun ka? Entaun ha'u husu ó, sira sufisiente ka? Ó-nia konsiénsia dehan sira sufisiente ka? Ka ó la haree katak razaun loos mak de'it ó-nia "hanoin isin nian ne'ebé mak inimigu hasoru Maromak" (Roma 8:7)? Ó la gosta harohan, tanba ne'e ó la gosta enkontru orasaun. Ó la hadomi Maromak, no tanba ne'e ó la hakarak komuñaun ho Nia. Ó la hadomi Ninia santu sira, tanba ne'e ó la hakarak hamutuk ho sira iha orasaun. Ó la preokupa kona-ba perdaun sala nian, no ó la gosta buat Kristu nian. "Buat hotu nia rohan besik ona; tanba ne'e imi sai sériu no vijila ba orasaun" (1 Pedro 4:7). "La husik halibur hamutuk, hanesan balun nia kostume..." (Ebreu 10:25).
cards.key_takeaway_en: The true root of neglecting prayer meetings is a carnal mind estranged from God; wake up, watch, and pray while there is time.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Abut loos husi neglijénsia enkontru orasaun mak hanoin isin nian ne'ebé dok husi Maromak; hadeer, vijila no harohan enkuantu sei iha tempu.
